```{ojs}
//| output: false
dados = await FileAttachment("./data/dados.tsv").tsv({ typed: true })

// you can serve files from rstudio-server directly, but these ignore range headers.
// igvjs mentions that this would be a performance issue, but only downloads the .fai file with range headers??
// all other tracks are downloaded fully (requests 200).

// so i don't see why not use rstudio-server instead of a python one.
// igvserver = "http://localhost:8787/files/files/analises/altss"
igvserver = "http://localhost:5497"
igv = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/igv@3.0.2/dist/igv.esm.min.js").then(m => m.default)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
library(readr)

# Defining TEX+ and TEX- samples by reading /samples/(filename).csv
# Also the TSSs which will show up in a table for you to quickly jump to portions of the genome is defined by tableall.
dados <- read_tsv(file = "./data/dados.tsv")
tableall = read_tsv("./results/candidates.tsv")

results <- list()
samples <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(dados)) {
  results[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read_tsv(paste0("./results/altss/", dados[i,]$Filenames, "-pTSS.tsv"))
  samples[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read.csv(paste0("./data/samples/", dados[i,]$Filenames, ".csv"), header = TRUE)
}
# ojs_define(dados = dados)
ojs_define(results = results)
ojs_define(samples = samples)
ojs_define(tableall = tableall)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

toUniprot = function(params) {
    const link = `<a href="https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=${params.value}" target="_blank">${params.value}</a>`;
    
    return link;
}
 

// The bulk of this code is defining tracks for IGV Browser.
// In short, we define an ag-grid, which when selecting a row of that grid, it fetches the TSS information in that row
// And load the IGV Browser with that TSS Information

mygrid = {
    document.querySelector("#myGrid").innerHTML = ""
    
    // Grid Options: Contains all of the Data Grid configurations
    const gridOptions = {
      // Data to be displayed
      rowData: transpose(tableall),
      // Columns to be displayed (Should match rowData properties)
      
      // Each one of these columns matches data available in your "tableall"
      // (which in this case, contains TSSs of 8 archaea species)
      // adjust it to your file.
      columnDefs: [
        { field: "filename", width: 150,  headerName: 'Species' },
        { field: "Chromossome", width: 150,  headerName: 'Chromosome' },
        { field: "Position",width: 130 },
        { field: "Pvalue", width: 100 },
        { field: "Strand", width: 30 },
        { field: "OriginalFile", width: 130, headerName: 'Library' },
        { field: "Gene", width: 180, headerName: 'Gene' },
        { field: "Protein", width: 180, cellRenderer: toUniprot },
        { field: "Product", width: 420, headerName: 'Function' },
        { field: "TSSCount", width: 140, headerName: 'n(TSS)' },
        { field: "gTSSDistance", width: 200, headerName: 'dist(TSS)' },
        { field: "total_ortho", width: 140, headerName: 'n(ortho)'  },
        { field: "Orthogroup", width: 140, headerName: 'Orthogroup'  },
        { field: "memenumsites", width: 140, headerName: 'n(motifs)' },
        { field: "SubClass", width: 90, headerName: 'Subclass'  }
      ],
      // Configurations applied to all columns
      defaultColDef: {
        filter: true,
      },
      // Grid Options & Callbacks
      pagination: true,
      rowSelection: { mode: "singleRow", checkboxes: false, enableClickSelection: true, copySelectedRows: true },
      onSelectionChanged: (event) => {
        // console.log("Row Selection Event!", event);
        if (event.selectedNodes.length == 0) return;
        const lineselected = event.selectedNodes[0].data
        
        // Upon selecting a line of the table, IGV loads tracks corresponding to the selected sample, 
        // and positions your cursor in the TSS position.
        
        // Information from the table can be fetched into variables here.
        const fn = lineselected[["filename"]]
        const start = parseInt(lineselected[["Position"]]) - 600
        const end = parseInt(lineselected[["Position"]]) + 600
        const locus = `${lineselected[["Chromossome"]]}:${start}-${end}`;
        
        const container = document.querySelector("#igv-container");
        
        // tracks
        const gettracks = async function() {
        
          // Because files may or may not exist, first an array of candidates is defined.
          //    ("May not exist" because paired files only exist for paired experiments)
          // Each element on this list corresponds to an IGV track, URL points to the file location.
          // 
          // The end goal is to compare blue x red colors. So Blue = TEX+, Red = TEX-.
          // Lighter colors is Positive Strand (FWD) and Darker colors Negative Strand (REV)
          // tex+: 44CCFF fwd; 011627 rev      tex-: F03A47 fwd; 5E0B15 rev
          // TEX+ and TEX- samples scale is grouped, since they'll be compared
          // 
          // For more information on how to add tracks (and available parameters), see
          // https://igv.org/doc/igvjs/#tracks
          
          let candidates = [
            {
              name: "Anotação",
              type: "annotation",
              format: "gff3", 
              url: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.gff`,
              searchable: true,
              color: "#6874E8",
              altColor: "#392759"
            },
            {
              name: "TSSAR-pTSSs",
              type: "annotation",
              format: "gtf", 
              url: `${igvserver}/results/altss/${fn}-pTSS.gtf`,
              searchable: true,
              color: "#6874E8",
              altColor: "#392759"
            },
            {
              name: "MEME Motif",
              type: "annotation",
              format: "gtf", 
              url: `${igvserver}/results/altss/${fn}-meme-pTSS.gtf`,
              searchable: true,
              colorBy: "motifid"
            },
          ]
          

          // If you select a TSS in the negative strand, load positive strand bedgraphs first.
          // If you select a TSS in the negative strand, load negative strand bedgraphs first.
          
          // Here I chose to copy paste the code, but invert the order.
          // It's lazy, and likely some array sorting instead would make this code less cluttered.

          if (lineselected[["Strand"]] == "+") {
              transpose(samples[fn]).forEach((samp, idx) => { 
                // fwd
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#44CCFF"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#F03A47"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#44CCFF"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#F03A47"
                });
              })
              
              transpose(samples[fn]).forEach((samp, idx) => { 
                // rev
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#011627"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#5E0B15"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#011627"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#5E0B15"
                });
              })
              
              
              
          } else {
          
            // THIS CODE IS THE SAME AS THE PREVIOUS ONE, BUT ORDER IS FLIPPED
            // (Reverse strand first, then forward strand)
              transpose(samples[fn]).forEach((samp, idx) => { 
                // rev
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#011627"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#5E0B15"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#011627"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `rev-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-rev.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#5E0B15"
                });
              })
              
              
              transpose(samples[fn]).forEach((samp, idx) => { 
                // fwd
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#44CCFF"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Paired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-paired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#F03A47"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#44CCFF"
                });
                candidates.push({
                  "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD Unpaired`,
                  "type": "wig",
                  "format": "bedGraph",
                  "autoscaleGroup": `fwd-unpaired-${idx}`,
                  "url": `${igvserver}/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-fwd.bedgraph`,
                  "color": "#F03A47"
                });
              })
              
              
              
              
          }
          
        async function urlExists(url) {
            try {
              let res = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' })
              return res.ok
            } catch (e) {
              return false
            }
        }
        
        // maps all candidates tracks to an async function (await promise)
        // where if the file exists (HEAD returns 200), then preserves track
        // otherwise replace the track by "null"
        const results = await Promise.all(candidates.map(async t => {
            if (!t.url) return null
            const ok = await urlExists(t.url)
            if (ok) return t
            return null
          }))
        
          // removes all "null" from results
          // This is the final value returned from "gettracks()"
          return results.filter(Boolean)
        }
        
        // So, you get the filtered, non-null, existing tracks
        // And append it to the options of a IGV Browser
        gettracks().then((v) => {
          const mytracks = v
          
          const options = {
            reference: {
              id: `${fn}`,
              name: `${fn}`,
              fastaURL: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.fna`,
              indexURL: `${igvserver}/data/genomes/${fn}.fna.fai`
            },
            tracks: mytracks,
            locus: locus
          };
          
          igv.removeAllBrowsers();
          igv.createBrowser(container, options)
        })
        
      },
      // Unused
      onCellValueChanged: (event) => {
        console.log(`New Cell Value: ${event.value}`);
      },
    };
    

    const myGridElement = document.querySelector('#myGrid');
    agGrid.createGrid(myGridElement, gridOptions);
}
```
